papers.title_en: Multilingual Brain Decoding Reveals Shared Cortical Semantic Geometry
papers.authors: Yi Guo, Yong Hu, Michael Kwok-Po Ng, Shuqiang Wang
papers.evidence: 多语言脑解码框架分析皮层语义几何
papers.tldr: 人类语言形式各异但语义相通，其神经基础尚不清楚。该研究开发多语言脑解码框架，分析227名中、英、法语参与者的脑记录，发现跨语言和个体间皮层语义表征呈现一致的几何关系，形成共享皮层语义几何。该一致性从感觉运动皮层向高级联合皮层递增，并与主要功能梯度对齐，为跨语言语义共性提供了神经基础。
papers.abstract_en: Human languages differ markedly in lexical and syntactic form yet can convey similar semantic content. The neural basis of this cross-language semantic commonality remains unclear. Here we developed a multilingual brain decoding framework and analysed brain recordings from 227 participants spanning Chinese, English and French. We found that cortical semantic representations exhibited consistent semantic geometry relationships across languages and individuals, revealing a shared cortical semantic geometry. Importantly, the cross-language consistency of cortical semantic geometry increased from sensorimotor to higher-order association cortex, forming a shared semantic geometry gradient closely aligned with the principal cortical functional gradient. Our work establishes generalizable multilingual brain decoding and identifies stable cortical semantic geometry as a neural basis for semantic commonality across languages.

papers.title_en: Scaling Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Brain Encoding
papers.authors: Zhuofan Josh Ying, Guanglong Sun, Nolan Ho, Kieran Liu, Rui Yang, Andrew Chen, Nikolaus Kriegeskorte, Pony Ma, Hossein Adeli
papers.evidence: 脑编码模型预测刺激引起的神经反应；参数高效微调提高效率
papers.tldr: 本研究针对脑编码中神经数据有限难以微调大模型的问题，提出使用参数高效微调（PEFT）适配大规模预训练骨干网络，并通过利用骨干因果结构单次预测多时间点降低计算成本，使最大104B参数的多模态模型得以适配。方法在9个骨干上提升性能，其中BrainLoRA在Algonauts 2025挑战赛取得最佳发表成绩，并保持可解释性。多LoRA加速内核支持200+模型集成，位居公开排行榜第一。
papers.abstract_en: Brain encoding models aim to predict neural responses to stimuli. The most widely used approach fits readouts from frozen pretrained backbones. Using neural data to train large models from scratch or fully fine-tune them after task-pretraining has proven difficult because neural data is costly and limited. We show that parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) enables us to effectively adapt very large pretrained backbones for brain encoding with a small number of trainable parameters. To make it computationally practical, we exploit the backbone's causal structure to predict multiple timepoints in a single pass instead of using sliding windows, significantly reducing feature-extraction cost. This enables efficient fine-tuning of multimodal backbones with up to 104B parameters, the largest model adapted for brain encoding to our knowledge. Trained with a low-rank adapter (LoRA) and a lightweight readout, our approach consistently improves brain encoding performance across nine diverse multimodal backbones. On the same Qwen3-Omni backbone as the prior state-of-the-art (SoTA), our method BrainLoRA achieves the best published performance on the Algonauts 2025 Challenge. We also show the adapted multimodal backbones remain interpretable: modality attribution recovers the canonical sensory topography that prior work often obtains by construction from separate unimodal encoders, and neural adaptation increases the contribution of audio inputs and cross-modal mixing within the backbone. To scale out the number of adapted models, we develop a multi-LoRA kernel that accelerates joint training of multiple LoRAs on a shared backbone. This enables an ensemble of 200+ adapted models that ranks first on the public Algonauts post-challenge leaderboard at the time of writing. Together, our results highlight PEFT as an efficient and powerful paradigm for brain encoding.

papers.title_en: Multiscale Temporal-Spectral-Spatial EEG Learning With Modality-Specific and Modality-Invariant Representations for Emotion Recognition
papers.authors: Jian Zhang, Manrong Liu, Yilei Huang, Wenhua Liu, Xiaohui Yang, Lijun Yang
papers.evidence: 多尺度时间-频谱-空间EEG学习用于情绪识别
papers.tldr: 多模态生理信号为情绪识别提供互补线索，但 EEG 模式随多种因素变化且不同模态兼具特异性与共享信息。本文提出 EEG 为中心的多模态框架 GMSI-Net，通过 TSSR 编码器建模多尺度时-频-空-脑区特征，并分别学习模态特异性与模态不变性表征，在 DEAP 和 MAHNOB-HCI 上取得高精度，表明融合 EEG 与互补外周生理信号能有效提升情绪识别性能。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal physiological signals provide complementary cues for emotion recognition. They also raise two related challenges. Emotion-related EEG patterns vary across time, frequency bands, electrodes, and brain regions. Different physiological modalities also contain both modality-specific and shared affective information. This paper presents GMSI-Net, an EEG-centered multimodal emotion recognition framework. It has three key components. The temporal-spatial-spectral-region (TSSR) encoder models multiscale temporal-channel patterns, differential entropy features, and local-to-global brain-region relations. The modality-specific representation (MSR) branch uses bidirectional cross-modal attention and learnable gates. It controls information transfer while retaining modality-specific cues. The modality-invariant representation (MIR) branch learns a shared affective representation. An adaptively weighted contrastive loss aligns this representation across modalities. Independent multiscale Conv-Transformer encoders process the peripheral physiological signals. GMSI-Net is evaluated on DEAP and MAHNOB-HCI using within-subject random ten-fold cross-validation. The model reaches 96.21 (1.47) and 96.41 (1.60) for valence and arousal on DEAP. It reaches 94.10 (2.86) and 94.48 (3.77) on MAHNOB-HCI. These results indicate that combining EEG features with complementary physiological information can improve emotion recognition.

papers.title_en: CNN-based classifier for subject-independent MBTI Extraversion/Introversion preference classification from short-time EEG signals
papers.evidence: 基于CNN分类器从EEG解码人格特质
papers.tldr: 本研究探究短时、最小预处理EEG信号能否区分MBTI外向/内向人格。针对50名参与者的4秒EEG片段，采用独立于受试者的嵌套5折交叉验证，比较EEGNet、EEGProgress和新提出的紧凑卷积网络SSCNet。SSCNet取得最高准确率(0.6481)、AUC(0.7063)和F1(0.6276)，且变异性最低、计算效率最优。结果表明MBTI E-I偏好可从短时域EEG适度预测，无需手动频谱特征提取，同时强调独立验证与高效模型设计的重要性。
papers.abstract_en: This study examines whether short, minimally preprocessed EEG segments contain sufficient information to distinguish between individuals classified as extraverted or introverted according to the Myers--Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI). EEG recordings from 50 participants were divided into 4-s segments and analyzed using a subject-independent nested 5-fold cross-validation procedure to compare EEGNet, EEGProgress, and a newly proposed compact convolutional architecture, SSCNet. SSCNet achieved the highest mean accuracy (0.6481), AUC (0.7063), and F1-score (0.6276). The proposed architecture also showed the lowest variability across folds. SSCNet demonstrated the best computational efficiency, with the shortest median training epoch time and the highest training throughput despite having a similar number of trainable parameters to EEGProgress. The results suggest that MBTI Extraversion--Introversion preferences may be moderately predictable from short time-domain EEG segments without manual spectral feature extraction, while highlighting the importance of subject-independent validation and computationally efficient model design.

papers.title_en: Rethinking EEG Spatial Super-Resolution as Dynamic State Decomposition and Filtering
papers.authors: Hongjun Liu, Leyu Zhou, Chang Ge, Shitong Duan, Chao Yao
papers.evidence: 使用时间滤波的EEG空间超分辨率以提高脑机接口信号质量
papers.tldr: EEG空间超分辨率旨在从稀疏电极观测恢复高密度神经信号，现有方法未显式建模当前状态中可预测演化与新出现变化两种信息源。本文提出动态状态滤波（DSF），将流式EEG超分视为序列状态滤波，结合历史感知动态分支与创新滤波分支，通过掩码约束拓扑感知转移算子和不确定性校正融合重建。在SEED、SEED-IV和BCI2000上，DSF提升了重建保真度与下游效用，对动态变化和不可靠稀疏观测具有鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: EEG spatial super-resolution aims to recover high-density neural signals from sparse electrode observations. Existing methods have achieved substantial progress through spatial modeling, generative reconstruction, and temporal representation learning. However, the current EEG state contains two different sources of information: predictable evolution inherited from preceding states and newly emerging changes revealed by the current observation. Most approaches typically do not model these two components explicitly. In this work, we formulate streaming EEG spatial super-resolution as a sequential state filtering problem and propose Dynamic State Filtering (DSF). Rather than relying on a single temporal reconstruction pathway, DSF combines a history-aware dynamical branch with an innovation-filtering branch that explicitly decomposes waveform-state estimation into prediction and observation-driven correction. To infer how spatially incomplete innovations should affect missing locations, DSF routes the observed innovations across electrodes through a mask-constrained, topology-aware transition operator and incorporates them through uncertainty-aware state correction. The two complementary estimates are finally fused to reconstruct the dense EEG signal. Experiments on SEED, SEED-IV and BCI2000 demonstrate that DSF improves reconstruction fidelity and downstream utility while maintaining robustness under dynamically changing and unreliable sparse observations.

papers.title_en: Observability-Aligned Diffusion and Null-Space Completion for EEG Source Localization
papers.authors: Zirui Wen, Shihao Yang, Feng Liu
papers.evidence: 提出基于扩散的框架用于EEG源定位，将头皮测量与神经源联系起来
papers.tldr: 脑电源成像因导联场矩阵秩有限和列强相关而严重欠定，头皮脑电仅约束可观测行空间分量，零空间不可观测。本文提出两阶段框架，将后验扩散细化与确定性零空间补全相结合，仅用模拟数据训练，在不同噪声水平下取得比传统和学习基线更高的帧级AUC、平均精度和更低定位误差。
papers.abstract_en: Electrophysiological source imaging is severely underdetermined because the lead-field matrix has limited rank relative to the source dimension and strongly correlated columns. Scalp EEG measurements constrain only the observable row-space component, leaving a high-dimensional null space unobservable. We propose a two-stage framework coupling posterior diffusion refinement with deterministic null-space completion. A minimum-norm-initialized, singular-coordinate Posterior-DDIM sampler combines a spatiotemporal diffusion prior with direction-dependent measurement reliability to refine the observable component. A frozen ridge predictor and nonlinear temporal residual network then estimate the null component under explicit projection constraints, preserving the refined row estimate and its predicted EEG exactly. All learned components are trained exclusively on simulated cortical activity and its row-null decomposition, without paired EEG-source training data. Across simulations with varying noise levels, the method achieved higher frame-level area under the receiver operating characteristic curve and average precision, together with lower localization error, than conventional and learning-based baselines. Exploratory evaluations on evoked EEG and simultaneous scalp EEG-stereo-EEG recordings showed condition- and event-dependent concordance with cross-modal and intracranial references.
